name: duet
description: Duet: Claude and Codex as one build pipeline. Codex establishes what is currently true, Claude owns judgement, and work is handed over as a goal that ends when a command exits zero rather than when a model stops talking.

plugins.name: duet
plugins.description: Claude leads; Codex checks the facts, builds the backend and writes the tests. Four fixed-stage presets (build an app, rescue a broken one, add a feature, build a skill), every stage ending in a runnable command rather than an opinion. Built to stop the failure where an AI confidently writes an API call that was removed two versions ago.
